requirements.text: Propose retaining audit events for 365 days.
requirements.quote: Keep audit events for three hundred sixty-five days instead of one hundred eighty days.
requirements.speaker: Eli
requirements.note: The approved retention is 180 days. Committee approval for 365 days is pending; indefinite retention was withdrawn.

requirements.text: Keep audit history append-only and represent corrections as new events.
requirements.quote: Audit events must remain append-only; corrections should create a new event.
requirements.speaker: Eli

requirements.text: Allow administrators to filter audit history by one actor identifier.
requirements.quote: Allow administrators to filter audit history by actor identifier.
requirements.speaker: Eli
requirements.note: The baseline provides per-record history but no general actor filter; free-text search was excluded.

requirements.text: Clarify the delivery deadline for the audit changes.
requirements.quote: Can you get it to us soon?
requirements.speaker: Nora
requirements.note: The committee date is unknown, so no deadline can be inferred.

expected_stories.title: Filter audit history by actor
expected_stories.i_want: filter audit history by one actor identifier
expected_stories.so_that: I can inspect actions by that account
acceptance_criteria: Given audit events from two actors, when I filter by one actor identifier, then only that actor's events are shown.
Given no matching events, when the actor filter is applied, then a clear empty state is shown.

questions: Does the committee approve 365-day audit retention?
What is the actual deadline for the annual review?
